title: @Biappi I like the clarification for histories sake as "semantic" as a modifier of HTML is quite different than what many recall with "semantic HTML"
summary: @Biappi I like the clarification for histories sake as "semantic" as a modifier of HTML is quite different than what many recall with "semantic HTML" as a noun. Especially when people are asking. Many different types of ideas get lumped together otherwise
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@Biappi I like the clarification for histories sake as "semantic" as a modifier of HTML is quite different than what many recall with "semantic HTML" as a noun.

Especially when people are asking. Many different types of ideas get lumped together otherwise
